summary: Iteration 12 — Dynamic sector taxonomy regression. Verified that a tenant created with sector='Perakende' returns retail-specific departments, skills clusters, career paths, strategic objectives, headcount targets, and positions across all dashboard endpoints, while the existing banking tenant 'yapikredi' continues to return banking taxonomy. 14/14 pytest tests passed.

tenant_create_and_seed.create_tenant_with_sector_perakende: PASS — POST /api/tenants persists sector='Perakende' (verified via GET)
tenant_create_and_seed.seeded_employees_use_retail_departments_: PASS — department_distribution contains only retail depts (Mağaza Satış, Üretim, Kalite Kontrol, Görsel Düzenleme, Perakende Operasyon, Bakım ve Teknik, Tasarım ve Ar-Ge, Kategori Yönetimi, İK ve Destek, Dijital ve E-ticaret). Zero banking dept leakage.

retail_endpoints.GET /api/dashboard/skills-map-v2?tenant=: PASS — retail clusters (core/retail/prod/hq) present; no banking cluster ids
retail_endpoints.GET /api/career-paths?tenant=<perakende>: PASS — exactly 10 paths returned, all with RL/PL/HL prefixes
retail_endpoints.GET /api/dashboard/workforce-alignment?t: PASS — retail strategic objective ids (perakende_deneyim, uretim_verimlilik, dijital_ticaret, tasarim_inovasyon, tedarik_zinciri, liderlik_yetenek). Banking ids dijital_donusum/risk_yonetimi absent.
retail_endpoints.GET /api/dashboard/positions?tenant=<per: PASS — retail band titles (Mağaza Müdürü, Satış Danışmanı, Üretim Operatörü, etc.)

banking_regression.GET /api/dashboard/overview?tenant=yapik: PASS — banking depts intact, no retail leakage

critical_code_review_comments: taxonomy_loader.py uses a module-level mutable _config_cache (dict). If the perakende_kutuphane.json is ever hot-edited, the cache is never invalidated until backend restart. Consider exposing a clear_cache() helper for admin reload, or use functools.lru_cache.

server.py is now ~2796 lines with many endpoints calling `sector = await _resolve_sector(tenant)` followed by `cfg = _cfg(sector)` boilerplate. Recommend a FastAPI dependency: `cfg: dict = Depends(get_tenant_cfg)` to DRY up >20 endpoints.

routes_auth.py seed_tenant_data lacks idempotency safeguard — calling seed twice will duplicate 500 employees per call. Either delete existing employees before seeding or return early if employee_count > 0 with a 'force=true' override.

_resolve_sector falls back to 'Bankacılık' when slug not in DB. This silent fallback could mask integration bugs where a typo in tenant slug returns banking data instead of a 404. Consider raising HTTPException(404, 'Tenant not found') from dashboard endpoints when tenant param is provided but not found.

Cookie security flags: routes_auth.py login sets secure=False on access_token/refresh_token cookies. Acceptable for preview but MUST be secure=True in production (currently the deployed URL is HTTPS so cookies could be hardened immediately).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted ephemeral Perakende tenants (slug prefix 'test-perakende-' and 'test-cleanup-'). 500 employees seeded per tenant during test then cleaned up on session teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic sector taxonomy is fully wired. test_perakende_sector.py is a reusable regression suite: it logs in via cookies, spins up a throwaway Perakende tenant, seeds 500 employees, validates 9 dashboard endpoints, then verifies yapikredi banking regression and cleans up. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_perakende_sector.py -v. To add a new sector (e.g., 'Saglik'), extend taxonomy_loader._build_<sector>_config() and add a parallel test class mirroring TestRetailEndpoints.
